newsitem.title: USA: Network Long Distance buys St. Louis co.
newsitem.headline: Network Long Distance buys St. Louis co.

text.p: Network Long Distance, Inc said Wednesday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire Universal Telecom Technologies Inc, an independent long- distance company in St. Louis, Missouri.

The company said this is its second acquisition of a mid-continent telecommunications concern in the past two months. The company recently announced plans to merge with United WATS Inc, a Kansas City, Missouri-based independent long distance carrier.
These acquisitions will help the combined companies to post a pro-forma run-rate in excess of $60 million in annualized revenues, Network Long Distance said.
Both transactions will be discussed in a teleconference at 9:15 a.m. Eastern Time on Thursday, November 14.
Network Long Distance shares were trading up 1/4 at 8-7/8 Wednesday afternoon.
